remarks: GORGEOUS Cottage to rent! Newly renovated, bright and exceptionally spacious one bedroom carriage house, with bonus room. Next to Tamarack country club, conveniently located for Westchester, NYC and all that Greenwich offers. A really exceptional rental. Be the first to live in this entirely newly renovated home! Not to be missed
